newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close the week firmer.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close the week firmer.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed the week firmer on Friday, with drugs firm Pliva trading on higher volumes.
* Eleven of 19 active issues rose, four fell and four were flat.
* Volume was slightly lower at 18,694 shares, turnover rose to 11.5 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer shipper Atlantska Plovidba added 43 kuna or 31.8 percent to 178, selling 444 shares.
* Biggest decliner Dalmatinska Banka lost 40 kuna, down 10 percent to 360 kuna with 85 shares sold.
* Most active Pliva edged down 15 kuna to 480 on volume of 9,470 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
